name: JCW's (The Burger Boys) Grilled Turkey Bacon Swiss Sandwich or Plain Charbroiled Burger
brandOrRestaurant: JCW's The Burger Boys (Orem / Lehi / South Jordan, UT)
whyItWorks: A popular lunch spot near both BambooHR (Orem/Lehi) and South Jordan; ordering the Grilled Turkey Breast & Swiss Sandwich on sourdough or a plain single Cheeseburger keeps fat and spice manageable.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Grilled Turkey Bacon Swiss (no tomato or lettuce) or a plain single Hamburger/Cheeseburger with aged cheddar or Swiss—ask for JCW's special fry sauce on the side.
watchOuts: JCW's famous shakes are huge and extremely high in lactose/sugar—skip shakes during flares or share a mini cup with lactase
